title: Tech Note: Implementing Drag-and-Drop with Entity/Collection Listboxes
author: Erick Lui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: On Begin Drag Over / On Drop

historical_commentary.text: The drag-and-drop patterns for entity-selection- and collection-based list boxes described here remain the current, standard 4D approach and are unchanged in modern versions — this is a durable reference for ORDA-era list box manipulation.
related_updates: Entity selection and collection manipulation methods (or, minus, combine, filter) used here remain current 4D ORDA/collection API
